_comment: 生成物，别手改。scripts/export-codex.ts 从 data/vanilla/units 与 vanilla-assets.json 生成。

desc.zh: 若无法守护应当守护之人，纵使苟活，武士亦与死人无异。
desc.en: A samurai who cannot protect those they are duty-bound to protect is no different from the dead, even if they cling to life.

desc.zh: 当阵列齐整时，这支部队在对抗敌军冲锋时会无视其所有的冲锋加成
desc.en: When bracing, this unit negates the charge bonus of any attacker.

desc.zh: 当阵列齐整时，这支部队可以对冲锋而来的敌军造成额外伤害
desc.en: When bracing, this unit causes additional damage when attacking charging enemies.

desc.zh: 当进行近战时，这支部队会尽量保持阵型，从而少量增加近战防御
desc.en: The unit will try to stay in formation when in melee. Melee defence will be slightly increased.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以隐蔽在森林里，除非敌人走到近前，否则他们不会被发现
desc.en: This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.
